personalInfo.name: Muhammad Afifudin
personalInfo.title: Web Application Developer, Backend Engineer, & Machine Learning Practitioner
personalInfo.subtitle: Specializing in Laravel, FastAPI, Scikit-Learn, and Scalable Web Systems
personalInfo.bio: IT graduate from Politeknik Negeri Jember (GPA 3.80) with hands-on experience in web application development, backend engineering, and machine learning implementation. Experienced in building high-performance systems with PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Python, and REST APIs. Proven track record building recommendation engines, computer vision monitoring platforms, and client-oriented digital solutions.

featuredProjects.title: Brilliant EdTech ML
featuredProjects.description: Machine learning-based English learning level recommendation system. Implements a Random Forest classification model trained and integrated via a high-performance FastAPI microservice, connected directly to a Laravel web portal for automated student level recommendations.

featuredProjects.title: Vehicle Monitoring Dashboard
featuredProjects.description: Smart parking area monitoring system based on Computer Vision for BUMDES Krian Cafe Dewi Pandawa. Processes real-time vehicle detection video feeds via a Flask microservice and delivers parking capacity analytics to a centralized Laravel dashboard.

featuredProjects.title: FinPocket
featuredProjects.description: Personal financial planning recommendation application developed as a Bangkit Academy Capstone project (Google, GoTo, Traveloka). Designed feature engineering datasets and trained ML models served via REST API for Mobile and Cloud team integration.

highlights: Developed a machine learning-based system to recommend appropriate English learning levels based on student data.
Implemented a Random Forest classification model using structured training and testing datasets.
Integrated the trained model with FastAPI to deliver lightning-fast prediction microservices to the Laravel web app.
Developed a web-based course marketing and student registration platform using Laravel MVC architecture.
Engineered reactive multi-step registration forms and administrative dashboards with Livewire & Alpine.js.
Secured authentication with Laravel Breeze and architected relational MySQL schemas for high transaction reliability.
